test_cases.title: Erişim belirteci olmadan istek gönderimi
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidi çalışmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Authorization başlığı içermeyen HTTP GET isteği.

steps.action: Authorization başlığı içermeyen bir HTTP isteği ağ geçidine gönderilir.
steps.expected: Ağ geçidi isteği reddeder ve HTTP 401 yanıt kodu döner.

test_cases.title: Geçersiz erişim belirteci ile istek gönderimi
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidi çalışmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçersiz veya süresi dolmuş bir OAuth 2.0 erişim belirteci içeren HTTP GET isteği.

steps.action: Geçersiz bir OAuth 2.0 erişim belirteci içeren bir HTTP isteği ağ geçidine gönderilir.
steps.expected: Ağ geçidi isteği reddeder ve HTTP 401 yanıt kodu döner.

test_cases.title: Arka uç servisinin zaman aşımına uğraması
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidi çalışmaktadır ve arka uç servisi yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli bir OAuth 2.0 erişim belirteci içeren HTTP GET isteği.
test_cases.assumptions: Arka uç servisi, isteğe 5 saniyeden uzun süre yanıt vermemek üzere yapılandırılmıştır veya simüle edilmiştir.

steps.action: Geçerli bir erişim belirteci ile ağ geçidine bir istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: Ağ geçidi isteği 5 saniye sonra sonlandırır ve HTTP 504 yanıt kodu döner.

test_cases.title: Client calls an endpoint assigned to its role
test_cases.preconditions: A client with a specific role is registered. The role is assigned access to a specific endpoint (e.g., /api/v1/data).
test_cases.test_inputs: Client credentials for the role, target endpoint URL assigned to the role.
test_cases.assumptions: The gateway is running and the target endpoint is available.

steps.action: Send an HTTP request to the endpoint assigned to the client's role using valid credentials.
steps.expected: The gateway forwards the request and returns a successful HTTP status code (e.g., 200 OK) from the backend service.

test_cases.title: Client calls an endpoint not assigned to its role
test_cases.preconditions: A client with a specific role is registered. The role is NOT assigned access to a specific endpoint (e.g., /api/v1/admin).
test_cases.test_inputs: Client credentials for the role, target endpoint URL not assigned to the role.
test_cases.assumptions: The gateway is running and the target endpoint exists in the system but is restricted.

steps.action: Send an HTTP request to the endpoint not assigned to the client's role using valid credentials.
steps.expected: The gateway rejects the request and returns HTTP status code 403 Forbidden.

test_cases.title: İstemci başına dakikada 600 istek sınırının uygulanması
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidi çalışmaktadır ve test istemcisi için istek sayacı sıfırdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tek bir istemci kimliği ile 600 adet geçerli HTTP isteği.
test_cases.assumptions: İsteklerin hepsi aynı dakika penceresi içinde gönderilir ve ağ geçidi istekleri başarıyla işler.

steps.action: Test istemcisinden 600 adet geçerli HTTP isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: Tüm 600 istek için HTTP 200 (veya ilgili başarılı durum kodu) yanıtı alınır.

test_cases.title: İstek sınırının aşılması durumunda HTTP 429 yanıtı ve Retry-After başlığı
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidi çalışmaktadır ve test istemcisi için istek sayacı sıfırdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tek bir istemci kimliği ile 601 adet geçerli HTTP isteği.
test_cases.assumptions: İsteklerin hepsi aynı dakika penceresi içinde gönderilir.

steps.action: Test istemcisinden 600 adet geçerli HTTP isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: İlk 600 istek için başarılı yanıt kodları (ör. HTTP 200) alınır.

steps.action: Aynı istemciden 601. istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: HTTP 429 yanıt kodu alınır ve yanıt başlıklarında Retry-After başlığı bulunur.

test_cases.title: İzleme ve istemci kimliği ile günlük kaydı doğrulaması
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidi çalışmaktadır ve günlük kaydı yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bilinen bir izleme kimliği ve istemci kimliği içeren tek bir HTTP isteği.
test_cases.assumptions: Günlük dosyasına veya sistemine erişim yetkisi vardır.

steps.action: Belirli bir izleme kimliği ve istemci kimliği ile bir HTTP isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: İstek başarılı bir şekilde işlenir.

steps.action: Yapılandırılmış günlük kaydı incelenir.
steps.expected: Günlükte ilgili istek için izleme kimliği, istemci kimliği, uç nokta, yanıt kodu ve süre bilgisi doğru olarak kaydedilmiştir.

test_cases.title: Configuration change applied without restart
test_cases.preconditions: The API Gateway is running and active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid configuration change (e.g., updating a rate limit value).
test_cases.assumptions: The gateway supports dynamic configuration reloading via its management interface.

steps.action: Apply a configuration change to the running gateway.
steps.expected: The configuration change is accepted and the gateway process remains running without a restart.

steps.action: Verify the new configuration is active by sending a request that depends on the changed parameter.
steps.expected: The request is processed according to the new configuration.

test_cases.title: In-flight requests not dropped during configuration change
test_cases.preconditions: The API Gateway is running and active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A long-running request (e.g., a large file upload or a slow backend response) and a configuration change.
test_cases.assumptions: A request can be initiated that takes a measurable amount of time to complete.

steps.action: Initiate a long-running request to the gateway.
steps.expected: The request is accepted and processing begins.

steps.action: While the request is in-flight, apply a configuration change to the gateway.
steps.expected: The configuration change is applied without interrupting the in-flight request.

steps.action: Wait for the in-flight request to complete.
steps.expected: The request completes successfully with the expected response, without being dropped or errored due to the configuration change.

test_cases.title: Classification of a valid document into a defined category
test_cases.preconditions: The Document Classification Service is running and accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid document clearly belonging to one of the 12 defined categories (e.g., 'Invoice').

steps.action: Submit the valid document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service returns a response containing a predicted category and a confidence score.

steps.action: Verify the predicted category in the response.
steps.expected: The predicted category is one of the 12 defined categories.

steps.action: Verify the confidence score in the response.
steps.expected: The confidence score is a numeric value between 0 and 1 (inclusive).

test_cases.title: Classification of a document with maximum confidence
test_cases.preconditions: The Document Classification Service is running and accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: A document that the model is expected to classify with very high certainty (confidence close to 1).
test_cases.assumptions: The model can produce a confidence score of exactly 1.0 for highly certain predictions.

steps.action: Submit the high-certainty document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service returns a response containing a predicted category and a confidence score.

steps.action: Verify the confidence score in the response.
steps.expected: The confidence score is 1.0.

test_cases.title: Classification of a document with minimum confidence
test_cases.preconditions: The Document Classification Service is running and accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: A document that is ambiguous or noisy, expected to yield a very low confidence score (close to 0).
test_cases.assumptions: The model can produce a confidence score of exactly 0.0 for highly uncertain predictions.

steps.action: Submit the ambiguous document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service returns a response containing a predicted category and a confidence score.

steps.action: Verify the confidence score in the response.
steps.expected: The confidence score is 0.0.

test_cases.title: Handling of an empty document
test_cases.preconditions: The Document Classification Service is running and accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: An empty file (0 bytes).
test_cases.assumptions: The service is expected to reject invalid inputs rather than crash or return a random category.

test_cases.title: Handling of a non-document file
test_cases.preconditions: The Document Classification Service is running and accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: A binary file that is not a document (e.g., an executable or image file with a .txt extension).
test_cases.assumptions: The service validates the content type or structure of the input.

steps.expected: The service returns an error response indicating that the input is not a valid document.

test_cases.title: Document with confidence score below 0.60 is routed to human review

test_cases.test_inputs: A document file that results in a confidence score of 0.50.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows monitoring of the human review queue status.

steps.expected: The document is processed by the AI model.

test_cases.title: Document with confidence score exactly at 0.60 is classified automatically

test_cases.test_inputs: A document file that results in a confidence score of 0.60.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows monitoring of the human review queue status and final classification results.

steps.expected: The document is processed by the AI model.

steps.action: Check the classification result and routing status of the document.
steps.expected: The document is assigned an automatic final classification. It is not added to the human review queue.

test_cases.title: Document with confidence score slightly above 0.60 is classified automatically
test_cases.preconditions: The Document Classification Service is running and accessible. A test document is prepared that the AI model will classify with a confidence score of 0.61.
test_cases.test_inputs: A document file that results in a confidence score of 0.61.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows monitoring of the human review queue status and final classification results.

steps.action: Submit the test document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The document is processed by the AI model.

test_cases.title: 95th percentile response time under 50 rps load
test_cases.preconditions: The service is deployed and operational. A load testing tool is configured to send 50 requests per second.
test_cases.test_inputs: A set of valid document classification requests sufficient to generate a statistically significant sample (e.g., 1000 requests).
test_cases.assumptions: The load generator can accurately sustain 50 requests per second. The network latency between the load generator and the service is negligible or accounted for in the measurement.

steps.action: Start the load test sending 50 requests per second to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service accepts all requests without immediate rejection or connection errors.

steps.action: Run the load test for a sufficient duration to collect at least 1000 response time samples.
steps.expected: The load test completes successfully, and response time data is recorded for all requests.

steps.action: Calculate the 95th percentile of the recorded response times.
steps.expected: The calculated 95th percentile response time is less than or equal to 500 ms.

test_cases.title: Verification of top three contributing passages for a single classification
test_cases.preconditions: The Document Classification Service is running and accessible. A test document containing at least four distinct text segments is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: A document with four distinct text segments: 'Segment A', 'Segment B', 'Segment C', 'Segment D'.
test_cases.assumptions: The service returns a structured response (e.g., JSON) containing a list of contributing passages for each classification label.

steps.action: Submit the test document to the classification service for processing.
steps.expected: The service returns a successful response containing classification results.

steps.action: Inspect the response for a specific classification label.
steps.expected: The response contains a list of exactly three text passages associated with that classification.

steps.action: Verify the content of the returned passages.
steps.expected: The three returned passages correspond to the text segments from the input document that the model identified as most influential for the decision.

test_cases.title: Verification of top three contributing passages for multiple classifications
test_cases.preconditions: The Document Classification Service is running. A test document is available that is likely to be classified into more than one category.
test_cases.test_inputs: A document with content relevant to at least two different classification categories.
test_cases.assumptions: The service supports multi-label classification or returns a list of classifications with associated passages for each.

steps.action: Submit the test document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service returns classification results for at least two categories.

steps.action: Inspect the response for the first classification label.
steps.expected: The response contains exactly three text passages for this label.

steps.action: Inspect the response for the second classification label.
steps.expected: The response contains exactly three text passages for this label, which may differ from the passages for the first label.

test_cases.title: Verification of contributing passages when document has fewer than three distinct segments
test_cases.preconditions: The Document Classification Service is running.
test_cases.test_inputs: A very short document consisting of only two distinct text segments.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement implies providing the top three. If fewer than three distinct segments exist, the behavior (e.g., returning fewer passages or repeating segments) is not explicitly defined in the requirement text, but the test verifies the system does not crash and returns a valid structure. Based on strict interpretation, if only 2 exist, it cannot provide 3 distinct ones. However, usually 'top 3' implies a limit. Let's assume the system returns up to 3. If the requirement strictly says 'the three', it might be an error case or return duplicates. Given the ambiguity, we test that the system handles the input without error and returns a list of passages. Let's assume the system returns the available passages (2) or pads. To be safe, we check that the response is valid and contains passages from the input. Let's assume the system returns exactly 3 if possible, or fewer if not. Let's stick to the requirement: 'provide the three'. If only 2 exist, it's a boundary. Let's assume the system returns 2 passages in this edge case, or 3 with duplicates. Let's write the test to check that the system returns a list of passages and does not fail. Let's assume the expected behavior is returning the available top passages (up to 3).

steps.action: Submit the short document with two segments to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service returns a successful response.

steps.action: Inspect the contributing passages for the classification.
steps.expected: The response contains a list of text passages. The number of passages is less than or equal to 3, and all passages are from the input document.

test_cases.title: İz güncellemesinin harita üzerinde 1 saniye içinde gösterilmesi

test_cases.title: Birincil sunucu arızasında yedek sunucunun 10 saniye içinde devralması
test_cases.preconditions: Sistem aktif olarak çalışmaktadır. Birincil ve yedek sunucular senkronize durumdadır. İz verisi akışı devam etmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Birincil sunucuya ani güç kesintisi veya ağ kopması simülasyonu.
test_cases.assumptions: Zaman ölçümü için milisaniye hassasiyetinde bir zamanlayıcı kullanılmaktadır.

test_cases.title: Offline functionality and local storage capacity verification
test_cases.preconditions: The application is installed on the tablet. The device is connected to a network. The local storage is empty of casualty records.

steps.action: Create the 500th casualty record while offline.
steps.expected: The 500th record is successfully saved locally.

steps.action: Verify the total count of locally stored casualty records.
steps.expected: The system reports exactly 500 casualty records stored locally.

test_cases.title: Synchronization of local records upon connectivity restoration
test_cases.preconditions: The application is in offline mode with at least one unsynchronized local record. The server is reachable.
test_cases.test_inputs: Local record ID: REC-101, Status: Modified

steps.action: Restore network connectivity to the server.
steps.expected: The application initiates the synchronization process.

steps.action: Wait for the synchronization process to complete.
steps.expected: The local record REC-101 is successfully transmitted to the server and marked as synchronized.

test_cases.title: Resolution of conflicting edits by keeping both versions
test_cases.preconditions: A record (REC-201) exists on the server. The local application has a modified version of REC-201. The server version of REC-201 has also been modified by another user since the last sync.
test_cases.test_inputs: Local REC-201: Field 'Notes' = 'Local Edit'. Server REC-201: Field 'Notes' = 'Server Edit'.

steps.action: Restore network connectivity to the server.
steps.expected: The application detects a conflict for record REC-201.

steps.action: Wait for the synchronization process to complete.
steps.expected: The system does not overwrite either version. Both the local and server versions are preserved.

steps.action: Check the application's conflict review queue or status.
steps.expected: Record REC-201 is flagged for manual review, displaying both the local and server versions.

test_cases.title: Synchronization failure handling when server is unreachable after connectivity restoration
test_cases.preconditions: The application is in offline mode with unsynchronized local records. The network connection is restored but the server is still unreachable (e.g., server down).

steps.action: Restore network connectivity but ensure the server endpoint is unreachable.
steps.expected: The application attempts to synchronize.

steps.action: Wait for the synchronization attempt to fail.
steps.expected: The application reports a synchronization error. Local records remain unsynchronized and are not lost.
